hints.title: Deepest Node Path Length
hints.text: Identify the maximum depth node from the root to determine the number of edges k on the longest path.

hints.title: Parity Combinatorics
hints.text: Each edge receives weight 1 or 2. The path sum is odd if and only if an odd count of edges receive weight 1.

hints.title: Binomial Identity
hints.text: Choosing an odd number of items out of k distinct elements yields exactly 2^(k - 1) valid configurations.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Breadth-first search followed by modular exponentiation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Enumerating all 2^k weight assignments is exponential.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: BFS traversal finds maximum depth in a single linear pass.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Derive the 2^(k - 1) parity formula using the binomial expansion.
